cohort: 83,911 patients who underwent surgery at Médecins Sans Frontières Brussels facilities from June 2008 to December 2012
finding: The most common surgical indication was for fetal-maternal pathologies, and the most common procedure was Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The most common procedure was a Cesarean delivery, accounting for a total of 24,182 or 25.9% of all procedures.
